Container.Name: EventSpace
Container.Author: donotknock
Container.Overview: EventSpace: A spatial, touch-friendly event management dashboard designed for visual thinkers. Combines freeform node graph canvas mapping with structured event logistics, overarching department checklists (FM, AV, CT), friction log tracking, OpenDyslexic accessibility typography, and unified single-port web/API serving. Includes instant pairing with the eventspace-mobile companion app for quick photo capture and AI audio summarization.

Config.Name: WebUI & API Port
Config.Description: Unified container port serving both the WebUI canvas and REST API

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent host directory for SQLite database storage (runs in WAL mode)

Config.Name: Mobile Companion PIN
Config.Description: Security PIN required to pair the mobile companion app with this EventSpace instance

Config.Name: Internal Port
Config.Description: Internal Express listening port (must match container port target)
